suggestions.pitch: Barkley is 29 and the contender partner gets a RB upgrade while I get the younger Olave, a 26-year-old WR who starts for me, in a rebuilding year.
Chase Brown is scoring 18.9 a week, far above his 12.6 projection, so sell high on him for the 23-year-old McMillan, who fits my rebuild.
Burrow's market value is high but he is producing nothing, so convert him into 22-year-old tight end Fannin, who would start for me with tight end premium.
